attempts.text:
**Rescue plan: car2 rescues 7 people, 15 are deferred, total cost 566**

**Car1 stays at Thakre shelter.** Its only two roads are unusable. The bridge to Panchakanya farm is washed away. Fast floodwater is running over the road to Trishuli care home, and a truck was swept off it this morning, so I treated it as closed. All rescues therefore use car2, which starts at Nilkantha hospital.

**Roads car2 uses:**
* Nilkantha hospital to Tadi village: 10 minutes
* Tadi village to Trishuli care home: 5 minutes
* Trishuli care home to Uttargaya market: 13 minutes

**Who is rescued and who is deferred:**

| Location | People | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| Uttargaya market | 4 adults | Rescue | Round trip is 56 minutes; deferring would cost 80. |
| Trishuli care home | 3 elderly | Rescue | Round trip is 30 minutes; deferring would cost 150. |
| Panchakanya farm | 1 adult | Defer (20) | Unreachable: its only road, from Thakre shelter, lost its bridge. |
| Belkot village | 1 adult | Defer (20) | Round trip is 62 minutes; deferring costs only 20. |
| Suryagadhi market | 4 elderly, 6 adults, 2 children | Defer (440) | It is 114 minutes each way, so each 4-person trip takes 228 minutes. Even the most costly group to defer (2 children and 2 elderly) costs 220, which is still less than one trip. |

The 3 elderly and 4 adults add up to 7 people, but car2 holds 4, so it makes two trips.

<plan>
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home uttargaya-market
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 uttargaya-market trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 elderly 3
defer panchakanya-farm adult 1
defer belkot-village adult 1
defer suryagadhi-market elderly 4
defer suryagadhi-market adult 6
defer suryagadhi-market child 2
</plan>

**Cost breakdown:**
* Driving: 56 + 30 = 86 minutes
* Penalties: 20 + 20 + 440 = 480

COST: 566
